stories.title: NEWS CENTER Maine Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Improving weather for Friday and the weekend

stories.title: Portland defeats Deering in 114th Thanksgiving Day Turkey Bowl
stories.summary: Bulldogs' offense dominates throughout. Portland 41, Deering 6.

stories.title: Maine teen builds golf simulator with nearly 15,000 courses at just 17-years-old
stories.summary: Northport teen Jason Thurston Jr., 17, created ShotForge, a golf simulator with nearly 15,000 courses and 500 users per month.

stories.title: Propane line failure sparks house fire as Lincoln family prepares Thanksgiving turkey
stories.summary: The homeowner sustained a minor burn on his head but refused transportation to a hospital.

stories.title: Windham man charged after two fires in two nights at same building
stories.summary: State investigators say both fires were set deliberately in the basement of a three-unit apartment building. No injuries were reported.

stories.title: Weather pushes Rockland's Festival of Lights to Saturday
stories.summary: Friday's events are canceled. Saturday's parade is still on for 6 p.m., with the lobster trap tree lighting right after.

stories.title: Bangor church feeds a free Thanksgiving meal to hundreds as need grows.
stories.summary: The meal organizers say it's a good opportunity for the community to build bonds while enjoying a meal together.

stories.title: Near-record turnout at Scarborough Community Thanksgiving as rising food prices impact celebrations
stories.summary: Hundreds attended the Scarborough Community Thanksgiving, finding comfort and connection in a tradition that’s more than just a meal.

stories.title: Drones and puppies join the search for missing Lewiston foster dog
stories.summary: A doorbell camera spotted 1-year-old Rousey after days without a sighting. She's since circled a food-baited trap.

stories.title: Rousey's rescue brings foster dog home
stories.summary: The 1-year-old Lab-husky mix is recovering with her foster caregiver after rescuers caught her Wednesday evening.

stories.title: CMMC suspends another nurse following union activity, bringing total to 21
stories.summary: The hospital has maintained that disciplinary action is unrelated to union efforts, but the union disagrees. All suspended nurses have advocated for the union.

stories.title: 12-year-old boy struck by car in Anson
stories.summary: A 12-year-old boy was struck by a car in Anson, says a Somerset County deputy. The driver reportedly didn't see him.
